correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the original APIILx CDF and differentiated to get h(x)=θ/(λ+x)·α(e^t−1)/(e^{αt}−1), t=−log(1−v/2). The exact logarithmic derivative is [θK_α(t(x))−1]/(λ+x); K_α=(e^t−1)[α/(1−e^{−αt})−1/(1−e^{−t})]. For α≤1, K≤0; for α>1, both e^t−1 and D_α(t) rise strictly because a/(1−e^{−at}) increases with a and sinh(z)/z with z. Therefore K increases from 0 to B(α)=α/(1−2^{−α})−2 as t increases while t(x) strictly decreases. This proves exact decreasing region θB≤1 (including equality on positive times), otherwise one strict peak and no bathtub/ever-increasing shapes. Scale λ cancels the boundary. Independent symbolic checks at α=1,2,3 confirm derivative identity; infinite claim is analytic.
